title: Counter Sale starts with no representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Part Sales page is open at {Location-A} in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide; nobody has set a representative on {Location-A}'s Counter Sale customer.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Create a new walk-in part sale (Counter Sale customer).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: its Sales Representative field reads "Unassigned".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R31, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R31: “The Counter Sale customer works like any other customer here. Each location's Counter Sale starts with no representative, so walk-in part sales start "Unassigned" unless the shop sets one on Counter Sale.”
